body:
The scheduled Progress board publisher fails because watchdog command diagnostics are duplicated in task notes and blocked reasons, and the snapshot copied the entire local task record. Publish the app card contract with bounded blocker excerpts, preserve the full local state, keep every open card, and reserve 10% of the unchanged server limit.

The existing agent points at `/Users/booko/carr-system-ruleapprove` on `claude/one-step-rule-approval`. Its source is `cmd_install_progress_board` in `ops/config-as-code.py`, rather than an `ops/launchd` template. `bin/fleet-sync.sh` and `ops/config/fleet-sync-siblings.json` intend the canonical `~/carr-system` checkout on main. Remove the pre-merge checkout exception. Fleet sync migrates the existing agent from canonical main after synchronization, preserving its schedule and canonical board state. Template installation refuses runtime paths into non-main worktrees; `check-launchd-main-paths` audits installed WorkingDirectory, Program and ProgramArguments paths read-only.

```text
local task state (full diagnostics retained)
  -> app card projection (blocker head + tail excerpt)
  -> completed/history trimming to 90% budget
  -> publish-board-snapshot (server limit unchanged)

fleet sync -> canonical main -> existing board agent
```

Measured the actual state file the installed job reads: `/Users/booko/carr-system/out/boards/carr-v5.json`. Freeze SHA-256 `7eb33a7e3173dc215171c158cdbb1e069b7e424f4b40aade96c47d154a1bacd6`; source baseline `323ab995`; 2,552,999 bytes, 867 tasks, 336 open. The census changed from 337 to 336 open while the live watchdog continued running; all before/after numbers below use one frozen read.

| Measurement | Before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Complete snapshot, UTF-16 JSON units | 2,379,222 | 235,703 |
| After removing every Live, Merged, History item | 1,956,760 (refused) | Fits before exhausting History |
| Open cards visible | 336 in the refused payload | 336 present in the fitted snapshot |
| Server limit | 262,144 | 262,144 |
| Reserved headroom | none | 26,441 |

Per-field census of local task records: `note` 921,796, `blocked_reason` 865,343, `stage_history` 93,688, `title` 51,537, `next_action` 23,620 units. The largest per-item records are:

| Task | Compact item units | Note units | Blocked-reason units |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `wd-42f9c0caac3429c1` | 56,872 | 28,200 | 28,132 |
| `wd-1e48ffcb2ca8a4ff` | 56,124 | 27,827 | 27,757 |
| `wd-7b2488e459180cff` | 56,124 | 27,827 | 27,757 |
| `wd-3ecf605eba64646c` | 56,124 | 27,827 | 27,757 |
| `wd-87bb012557f8e8b4` | 56,124 | 27,827 | 27,757 |

Measured each top-level field, each task, and each task field. The measurement artifact remains local in `out/board-size-measurements.json`; it contains sizes and identifiers, with no business diagnostic text. The snapshot drops local-only diagnostic metadata and duplicate notes; long blockers retain the first and last 96/95 characters. Status, next action, timing history, PR/review evidence and model identity remain visible. Existing completed/history omission counts still describe trimmed entries. The display projection does not mutate the state file.

Tests were written and run against the unmodified origin/main implementation first. `tools/test-progress-board-size.py` raised SnapshotTooLarge at 2,327,313 units; `ops/launchd-main-path-selftest.py` accepted each feature runtime path and reached installation. Both pass after the fix. The full board suite passed 94 tests, launchd installer suite passed 50 checks, and fleet sync coverage includes canonical board migration. Symlink, absent-script and dependency-release-branch cases also pass.

Ran `./ops/ci.sh --strict`. The full local run returned nonzero: unit dependency setup was missing `practice-plugin`'s locked Wrangler install, gate fixture isolation needed the explicit scrubbed Git fixture environment, and committing while the suite ran tripped its tree-integrity guard. Those causes were corrected. On the unchanged final head, `./ops/ci.sh --strict --only unit` passes and `./ops/ci.sh --strict --only gates` passes (508 selftest suites plus baseline integrity). Types, contract, replay (7,384 matching invocations), secret, dependency, artifact and freshness passed in the full run.

The remaining full-local limitations are explicit: binding refuses two installed agents, `com.carr.cliproxyapi.plist` and `com.carr.fix-train.plist`, whose sources are absent from origin/main; changing the reconciler makes this machine drift fatal under the existing ownership check. Neither installed agent was modified or captured into this PR. Migration skipped because no local `CARR_CI_DATABASE_URL` is configured; no production database was used.

Hosted CI on head `215592fcfc6012a4f00c95d827098902039ba724` has passed the strict pushfloor/unit/types/contract/secret/dependency/binding/artifact/freshness group and replay. Hosted gates and both migration checks are still in progress at final readback; this PR remains open and unmerged. The installed-path audit was run read-only and correctly refuses the existing Progress board feature-worktree path.

The installed plist was only read. No production deployment, force push, merge or paid Claude API call was performed. The orchestrator can reload after merge. Reverting source is possible; no board items or local diagnostics are deleted. This reduces the manual attention needed to restore unattended board reporting.
